parts.html: The K-05 model from our catalog is a classic L-shaped kitchen in soft beige shades with a porcelain stoneware countertop.
Beige is a warm, light color, and furniture in it does not make a room feel heavy. The fronts are painted in a solid color, with the upper and lower rows in the same shade.
Work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinets run along two walls, and with no island there is more room for a dining area.
The texture of the porcelain stoneware countertop stands out clearly against the solid beige fronts.
The look is classic, but the hardware is modern: Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and drawers on concealed Muller Profi Line slides.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line

At a free consultation we will discuss how to adapt the K-05 to your walls, utility connections, and appliances. We deliver and install in Bratislava and Vienna, and delivery is included in the price.
